assets.review_notes: Recognizable wolf and stable sampled motion. Fur geometry and face projection remain soft; bounded torso smoothing plateaued, original retained.
Promising armored rest silhouette. Severe running limb sheets; assisted reweighting worsened underside. Preserve hide; matched anatomy and limb skin rebuild required.
Source fused opaque fronds. Corrected joined leaflet rebuild improves separation and canopy after sparse first pass was rejected.
Bent supports and missing readable ladder. Corrected trimmed joined supports retain roof/balcony; first protruding-post pass rejected.
Readable thin blade and jade hilt after upright inspection. Dark muddy baked blade obscures steel in the concept. Separate blade material locally; preserve successful hilt and profile.
Bark is intentional. Thin body, detached foliage and large foot/hand fans in running; anatomy and skin correspondence unresolved.
Readable brown boar at rest, but large forelimb sheets in run quarter poses. Eyes/tusks soft. Skin/anatomy correspondence requires local rebuild.
Recognizable silvery wolf; sampled running remains readable. Surface bumps and indistinct eyes need local geometry/texture work, not global normals.
Tree hide appropriate. Thin torso and fused foliage; running hands and feet stretch into fans.

Every clip sheet opened: short reed legs remain readable in attack/death/hit/idle/run, with a small disconnected side fragment. No broad running sheets like copper or widow. Preserve anatomy, inspect/remove only proven isolated debris.
Head faces opposite the rig-compatible blue wolf; severe moving front/hind limb sheets. Inspect mesh coordinates against head/leg bones before yaw correction.
Head faces opposite the rig-compatible meadow wolf; large running limb sheets. Saved mesh and bone correspondence must establish orientation cause.
Woody armor intentional. Lower body fused and feet fan in run; preserve promising chest, rebuild matching articulated lower limbs.
Mud armor and head are promising; running creates extreme limb/tusk sheets. Weight normalization does not prove anatomical compatibility.
Readable copper carapace and rest legs. Motion stretches legs into broad strips; joint correspondence needs local skin/leg rebuild.
Dark blue wolf retains recognizable silhouette and readable run samples. Eyes/fur detail soft in both geometry and projection.
Very thin side profile, elongated face and fused weapon; severe cloth/leg fans. Prepare separated neutral-pose reference rather than smoothing incompatible anatomy.
Leaf-covered brown wolf suits concept and sampled running reads correctly. Preserve fur/leaf features; only localized surface/eye detail work.
Recognizable dark boar, comparatively readable running without the extreme sheets seen in ironhide. Small paw artifact and weak tusk/eye definition remain.
Green carapace suits concept. Running underside/legs form sheets; rebuild leg regions after explicit skin/anatomy inspection.
Rocky hide is intentional; massive fist and chest readable. Thin side profile and long running foot sheets require matching lower-limb anatomy.
Hood silhouette recognizable frontally but paper-thin body, fused weapon and severe running cloth sheets. Neutral separated reference needed.
Skull, ember body and separated trailing swirl recognizable; sampled motion stable. Transparent fire/material detail remains soft; intentional floating pieces retained.
White ruff and muzzle readable, sampled running stable. Small geometric pinholes and soft eyes need local repair; global smoothing would erase fur.
Concept long articulated legs became short fused appendages and broad abdomen. Running abdomen stretches into sheets; rebuild matching legs/skin.
Thin side profile and fused held blade, running skirt/legs form large fans. Front appearance alone does not meet human anatomy target.
Turquoise spectral ribbons and floating body appropriate, motion stable. Material clarity and torso emblem soft; intentional openings are not accidental holes.
Rocky ember fur suits lava concept; recognizable hound and readable running. Eye/emission contrast can improve without flattening hide.
Segmented rocky arms/torso recognizable. Running feet stretch into long sheets, requiring articulated lower-limb correspondence.
Rest spider readable, but concept translucent crystal distinction lost and moving legs become flat strips. Skin and material regions need separate attention.
Dark crouched wolf retains silhouette and readable run. Hide noise blends with dark projection; inspect UV allocation before face repaint.
Red mane and muzzle recognizable and run samples readable. Face definition and local rough surface need polish, preserving intentional mane.
Long spectral standard and swirl match concept structure; motion stable. Ember core/material contrast weak, not a structural hole defect.
Promising armored lava boar at rest; running front legs and underside stretch badly. Preserve rocky hide; matched joint anatomy needed.
Dark red abdomen and spider outline readable at rest; walking legs stretch into broad sheets rather than articulated limbs.
Captain armor front recognizable but body/weapon fused and very thin; running cloth and feet form large fans. Isolated neutral reference needed.
Tattered floating standard and blue ribbons recognizable; motion stable. Improve core/blue material contrast, retaining intended fragments.
Violet segmented stone body suits concept, lower feet produce elongated moving sheets. Lower-limb rebuild required, not smoothing stone plates.
Mossy stone body appropriate but fused lower limbs and severe running sheets. Preserve torso; matching leg anatomy required.
Heavy stone chest and arms retained; source lower legs already thin/disconnected, motion creates feet sheets. Missing articulated structure is not shading.

Armor, head and red skirt useful. All clips opened in readable crops: sleeve fans during attacks/skill_plant and calf/cloth fans in run. Rebuild local skin correspondence while preserving face, torso, clip names and sockets.

Bay rest proportions and separate tack are promising. Actual walk/trot/canter previews show forehoof triangular fans. Diagnose lower-leg joint correspondence and rebuild local weights; generic run row did not exercise horse gaits.
Trunk/canopy structure recognizable but foliage is opaque angular clumps rather than fine needles. Rebuild canopy regions with separated leaf geometry, preserve trunk.
Slate silhouette, grounded shape and textured rock surface appropriate; organic irregularities harmless at gameplay distance.
Opaque fused canopy with broad planar facets rather than separate leaves. Leaf-region remodel required, texture resolution alone cannot create gaps.
Readable tiled roof, timber/plaster separation and grounded walls. Small roof/post irregularities visible close up but coherent at gameplay distance.
Robe front readable but nearly flat profile and projected, malformed face. Reference isolation and consistent neutral views needed; normals cannot restore volume.
Branch silhouette, broken crown and bark appropriate; intentional dead branch openings and mild organic irregularities retained.
Readable grounded log, end grain and bark; small irregularities appropriate to decayed wood.
Apron/front readable but very thin body and stretched projected face; concept heavy smith volume absent. Isolated neutral reference needed.
Roofed stone pile and open posts recognizable. Slight post waviness and soft tile texture need local architectural polish; central opening intentional.
Canvas A-frame and intentional entry opening retained, silhouette and fabric read at gameplay distance.
Arch opening is intentional, ruined masonry coherent. Thin profile and soft stone relief need local depth/detail polish; no global hole filling.
Outfit front reads but profile nearly flat and face projection malformed; recover volume with consistent isolated neutral reference.
Individual blades became opaque folded sheets. Rebuild blade canopy rather than smooth fused mass or upscale its texture.
Open thorn ring and orange suspended core recognizable. Roots appropriately noisy; improve core material contrast, preserve intentional openings.
Intentional square opening retained. Coin silhouette and gold relief readable; wavy rim and soft embossing require limited local detail work.
Crate planks and brace read at gameplay distance. Skewed corners and soft top grain need limited structural/texture polish.
Useful deck and posts, but rope rails are largely missing and deck droops asymmetrically. Rebuild rail/post regions while preserving collision traversal.
Derived grounded log retains readable bark/end silhouette; independently opened all views.
Fused low frond crown, missing separated leaflets. Reuse the verified dense joined-frond rebuild with matching source extent and placement.
Flat ground cover is intentional. Opaque folded patches and soft projection are visible; keep ground pivot and improve material separation locally.
Opened all views: recognizable slate ground forms; faceting and cracks suit the concept, no blocking artifact at normal distance.
